business_type: cyclical (low-margin optics manufacturer in a capacity-ramp phase)
moat_source: no durable moat identified: 29-30% gross margin, hyperscaler customers that have dual-sourced away before, and commodity-trending transceiver products; the current advantage is temporary supply scarcity

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3. Per-share math uses ~60M shares (see notes).

sensitivity_key_driver: hyperscaler socket retention through the capacity ramp
primary_model_risk: Customer concentration: the base case assumes AAOI keeps its 800G socket while 6.5x-ing capacity. AAOI has lost hyperscaler orders abruptly in prior cycles; if that repeats after the capex is spent, the bear case ($2.50) understates nothing - the company would carry stranded capacity and losses.
expectations_gap_key_variable: sustainable margin: at ~$121 (~10x+ forward sales on a breakeven, 29-30% GM assembler) the price assumes AAOI converts the 800G scarcity moment into durable double-digit FCF margins it has never once achieved in its public history
top_5_bull_arguments: First volume 800G shipments to a large hyperscaler with demand exceeding capacity through mid-2027 per management
Capacity ramp 100K to 650K+ units/month by year-end 2026 - if sold through, revenue could triple
Q2 2026 guide ($180-198M) puts breakeven within reach for the first time this cycle
CATV segment ($66.8M/quarter) diversifies away from pure AI capex
Scarcity pricing through mid-2027 gives a window to build cash before competition normalizes
top_5_bear_arguments: Expected IV ($30.1) is roughly a quarter of the current price - the widest gap on this watchlist after RKLB
29-30% gross margin against 45%+ at Coherent/Lumentum: AAOI is the price-taker in the room
Still lossmaking at record revenue; Q1 missed guidance midpoint on EPS
6.5x capacity expansion into a cyclical peak is how optics companies destroy capital (AAOI's own 2018-19 history)
One dual-sourcing decision by its lead hyperscaler ends the story - it has happened to AAOI before
thesis_breakers: Loss or material reduction of the lead hyperscaler 800G program
Q3/Q4 2026 guidance implying the 650K units/month capacity will not be absorbed
Failure to reach sustained non-GAAP profitability by Q4 2026
A capital raise to fund the ramp at dilutive terms
position_size_recommendation: 0%; this is a trading vehicle, not an investment, at current prices - no margin of safety exists under any modeled scenario
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: company is lossmaking; no sourced ratios exist. DCF heavily degraded: no positive FCF has ever been sourced for this name; all cash-side inputs are constructed. Snapshot carries a price/market-cap inconsistency (121.26 vs 9.71B implying ~162); per-share math uses the ~60M share count consistent with both source pairs, and the lower price - if the true price is ~162, the overvaluation conclusion only strengthens.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: -6.33% past week, prior episodes of hyperscaler order loss referenced across coverage (2018-19 era), Q1 2026 EPS/revenue miss (8-K). No verified 5-year multiple range captured.
